messages:
Anya (SRE): I'm taking primary for the 10:00-18:00 PT shift — handing off from Mike. Quick summary: ongoing incident IN-4521 (embeddings latency spike) is active but in mitigation. I've read the runbook and replayed the last mitigation steps. See notes below.

Oncall Bot: Incident IN-4521: Severity 2 - Embeddings latency > 1.5s. Page routed to primary Anya (SRE) at 2026-06-04T09:55:12Z.

Mike B: Handoff notes:
- What happened: sudden increase in tokenization queue time, correlated with cache miss rate spike on pool-emb-01.
- Mitigation applied: scaled emb-worker pool from 6 -> 12, enabled prefix KV cache warmer, rerouted non-critical customer traffic to emb-fallback-v2.
- Current customer impact: approx 5% of embeddings requests see 2-3s extra tail latency; no errors. A small subset of customers (IDs in ticket) saw timeouts earlier, now resolved.

Sara K: Thanks Mike. Anya — main things to watch during your shift:
1) Error rate / timeouts on route /v1/embeddings (dashboard: /dash/emb/latency).
2) CPU on emb-worker hosts (emb-worker-*-pool). If CPU > 85% for 5m, revert to previous autoscaler step and contact infra.
3) Watch prefix cache hit ratio; if it stays < 60% after 15m, run the warmer job again.

Anya (SRE): Confirmed. My checklist while primary:
- Confirm health checks for emb-worker pool pass.
- Keep runbook link handy: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-degradation
- If latency not improving in 20m, escalate to infra and trigger canary rollback to emb-fallback-v2.

Oncall Bot: Runbook excerpt (command snippets):
```
# check cache hit ratio
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=emb_cache_hit_ratio | jq .value

# scale pool
redwood infra scale pool emb-worker --replicas 12

# warm cache
redwood jobs run cache-warmer --target-prefix "common_" --batch 5000
```

Dave L: Heads-up — I'm on standby for infra scaling if you need help with node reboots or kernel tuning. Also noted a small maintenance window tomorrow that reduces spare capacity in us-west-2 (12:00-13:00 PT) — might be a coverage gap if this keeps flapping.

Anya (SRE): Acknowledged. I'll avoid major changes before that window. Post-handoff action items I'm creating now:
- IN-4521: add timeline and mitigation steps to ticket (assigned to Mike B).
- TICKET OPS-993: add automation to retry cache-warmer on failure (assigned to Sara K).
- Schedule a short retro for tomorrow 09:30 PT to review root cause and autoscaler tuning (calendar invite outgoing).

Mike B: Filed the follow-ups:
- IN-4521 updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IN-4521 (notes + current mitigations).
- OPS-993 created for retry automation: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-993

Luis: Quick note on customer comms — CX drafted an FYI template in #customer-success. If we end up with longer impact window, we should send targeted messages to the affected customer list in IN-4521. I can take point if needed.

Anya (SRE): Thanks Luis. I'll loop CX in if latency hasn't normalized within 1 hour. For now status: mitigations active, monitoring. Coverage note: after my shift ends at 18:00 PT, Mike returns as primary for night; Mike, please confirm you can accept handoff early at 17:45 if anything regresses.

Mike B: I can take handoff at 17:45 if needed. If everything looks stable at 18:00, standard handoff stands.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: runbook checkpoint items not yet completed: cache-warmer success (false).

Anya (SRE): I'll re-run the warmer now and post logs.

Anya (SRE): Ran warmer:
```
redwood jobs run cache-warmer --target-prefix "common_" --batch 5000 --timeout 10m
# output: warmed 4.6M keys, failures 0, avg latency 120ms
```
Cache hit ratio climbed from 43% -> 71% over 8 minutes. Latency trends improving on dashboards.

Sara K: Nice. Marking warming step done in the runbook. Please add any command outputs to IN-4521 for the retro.

Anya (SRE): Added logs to the Jira ticket. Creating a short retro doc and assigning owners for action items.

Dave L: Action item: infra to add canary pool capacity guard for maintenance windows. Ops-994 created.

Anya (SRE): Wrapping up handoff thread. Current state: mitigations active, latency trending down, customer impact limited but tracked. Next handoff: Mike B at 18:00 PT (or 17:45 if regression). Retro scheduled 09:30 PT tomorrow; tickets IN-4521, OPS-993, OPS-994 are created.

Mike B: Thanks Anya. Good handoff. I'll watch the dashboards through the night. :thumbsup:

Oncall Bot: Thread closed for handoff notes. To reopen or add updates, reply to this thread.
